title: RIP-Seq
method_names: Native PRC2 RIP-seq (Zhao et al., 2010; PMID 21172659)
scope: Illumina explanatory schematic and the distinct native PRC2 RIP-seq implementation supported by its cited Zhao et al. primary paper (PMID 21172659). The drawing shows one linear route: RNA-protein complex → immunoprecipitation → RNase digestion → RNA extraction → reverse transcription → cDNA. The disconnected far-left RNA immunoprecipitation (RIP) icon is an overview, without a transfer arrow into the chain. No branches, end-group labels, barcodes, legend or library-adaptor structures are shown. The primary-supported native route is recorded separately, without the schematic RNase-trimming step; these two graph components distinguish evidence scopes rather than depict an experimental branch. Sequencing/library interfaces supplied by the paper are explicitly confined to the native implementation. Separate UV-crosslink RIP/RT-qPCR validation in that paper is not the sequenced-library route.

operations.label: Immunoprecipitate RNA-protein complex
operations.description: Capture RNA-protein complexes with antibodies to the protein of interest. The output retains RNA associated with the selected protein.
operations.mechanism: Antibody recognition of the target protein.
operations.information_effect: Links membership in the recovered RNA pool to association with the captured complex. Nonspecific antibodies can recover nonspecific complexes, and lack of complex stabilization can lose associations, as acknowledged by the card.

operations.label: RNase digestion
operations.description: Digest accessible RNA in the captured complex; the retained output is RNA protected by protein binding, as stated by the card.
operations.mechanism: RNase digestion; enzyme identity and cleavage end chemistry are unspecified.
operations.information_effect: Restricts represented RNA toward protected segments; biological specificity still depends on antibody specificity, and the card cautions that RNase digestion must be controlled carefully.

operations.label: Native α-Ezh2 RNA immunoprecipitation
operations.description: Capture native nuclear RNA-protein complexes from mouse embryonic stem-cell lysate with α-Ezh2 and protein A agarose beads. The output retains RNA associated with the captured PRC2 complex.

operations.label: RNA extraction from native RIP
operations.description: Extract RNA from the captured native complexes. Unlike the Illumina RNase-digestion depiction, the primary library-production route reports no intervening RNase trimming; the output is recovered native RIP RNA.
operations.mechanism: RNA extraction reported with Trizol; no additional extraction steps are reconstructed.
operations.information_effect: Releases selected RNA from protein/bead attachment while retaining its sequence identity; no footprint boundaries are introduced by a reported trimming step.

evidence.locator: RESULTS, [b00027], RNase pretreatment validation distinct from library production
evidence.quote: To confirm the nature of nucleic acids precipitated by α-Ezh2, we pretreated nuclear extracts with RNases of different substrate specificities. Digesting with single-stranded RNase (RNase I) and double-stranded RNase (RNAse V1) abolished RNA pulldown, whereas digesting with RNase H (which degrades the RNA strand in RNA:DNA hybrids) and DNase I had no effect (Fig. 4E).

operations.label: Strand-preserving cDNA library construction
operations.description: Convert recovered RNA to first-strand cDNA using Adaptor1 and template switching, amplify adaptor-bearing cDNA with Illumina primers, and select cDNA products for sequencing. This broad paper-supported block supplies a library interface for the native route only.
operations.mechanism: Superscript II adds non-templated CCC at the cDNA 3′ end, which hybridizes to the GGG-bearing template-switch primer. The described construction preserves strand information.
operations.information_effect: Transfers selected RNA sequence to an amplifiable DNA library while retaining strand assignment through the directional adaptor/template-switch design.

operations.label: Illumina sequencing and genomic placement
operations.description: Sequence the native RIP cDNA library and align RNA-derived sequences to the mouse reference genome, interpreting read orientation relative to the source RNA. The output is a strand-resolved representation of associated RNAs.
operations.mechanism: Illumina GAII sequencing followed by genome alignment; detailed processing thresholds are outside this architecture.
operations.information_effect: Reads identify RNA sequences and their genomic origins within the protein-selected pool. Read sequence is opposite to the bound RNA strand. Native RIP sequencing alone does not yield single-nucleotide protein-contact sites or prove direct binding for every recovered RNA.
